title: Law on Accounting (Zakon o računovodstvu), Article 37: non-financial reporting
citation: Zakon o računovodstvu (Sl. glasnik RS 73/2019, 44/2021 - dr. zakon), Art. 37
evidence: Final Article 66 of the Law as adopted: "Овај закон ступа на снагу 1. јануара 2020. године." (National Assembly PDF https://www.parlament.gov.rs/upload/archive/files/cir/pdf/zakoni/2019/2368-19.pdf, opened 2026-11-02); published in "Службени гласник РС", бр. 73 од 11. октобра 2019 (header line of the Pravno-informacioni sistem entry, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Record text is the whole Law as adopted by the National Assembly (Cyrillic; the Latin script the gazette also serves is the same text). Article 37 reads: "Обвезници нефинансијског извештавања су велика правна лица која су друштва од јавног интереса и која на датум биланса прелазе критеријум просечног броја од 500 запослених током пословне године." The Pravno-informacioni sistem title of the current consolidation is "73/2019, 44/2021 - др. закон": the 2021 text is marked as an amendment made by another law; it is not in the Assembly PDF and its effect on Article 37 was not read, so later amendments are not stored. No 2025 or 2026 amendment aligning the Law with the CSRD appears in that title, in the 14th-convocation list of adopted laws on parlament.gov.rs (searched for "рачуноводств"), or on the Ministry of Finance page (mfin.gov.rs answers 403 to the cloud address, row RS-MFIN-ADOPTED), on 2026-11-02. The Ministry page named in the register row before this update was https://mfin.gov.rs/propisi/-zakon-o-racunovodstvu-sluzbeni-glasnik-rs-br-732019. No government English translation found on 2026-11-02: looked on the Assembly site (no English text of laws), ekologija.gov.rs (WordPress API search "Climate", "Environment", "Law on": only international declarations), ekologija.gov.rs/en/ (home page 200, no legislation page), srbija.gov.rs/en/ (home 200, no translations) and the Ministry of Finance (mfin.gov.rs/en/, 403) and Trade (mtt.gov.rs, refused) sites.

title: Law on the Tax on Greenhouse Gas Emissions (Zakon o porezu na emisije gasova sa efektom staklene bašte)
citation: Zakon o porezu na emisije gasova sa efektom staklene bašte (Sl. glasnik RS 109/2025, 80/2026)

notes: Record text is the Law as adopted (Cyrillic). The Pravno-informacioni sistem title is "6/2016, 52/2019 - др. закон": the 2019 text was made by another law and is not in the Assembly PDF, so it is not stored. Art. 10 ("Забрана подстицања угрожавања здравља и безбедности"), item 5, forbids advertising that "подстиче или одобрава поступке који су забрањени прописима о заштити животне средине, као и изношење неистинитих тврдњи (нпр. истицањем речи „еколошки сигуран”, „еколошки нешкодљив”, „еко храна”, „органски производ” и сличних речи или симбола) да роба или услуга имају позитиван или нешкодљив утицај на заштиту здравља или животне средине" (read in the extracted text); Art. 11 forbids misleading advertising generally. It is the Serbian umbrella for environmental claims, read together with the Law on Consumer Protection (rs-consumer-protection-act). title: Law on Consumer Protection (Zakon o zaštiti potrošača), unfair commercial practices Arts. 17 to 20
citation: Zakon o zaštiti potrošača (Sl. glasnik RS 35/2026), Arts. 17 to 20
evidence: Article 220 of the Law as adopted: "Овај закон ступа на снагу осмог дана од дана објављивања у „Службеном гласнику Републике Србије”, а примењује се по истеку три месеца од дана ступања на снагу овог закона, осим члана 4. став 1. и члана 6, који почињу да се примењују ступањем на снагу овог закона." (National Assembly PDF .../zakoni/14_saziv/1317-26.pdf, opened 2026-11-02); header of the PIS entry: "Службени гласник РС", број 35 од 23. априла 2026., so the eighth day is 2026-05-01 and most provisions apply from 2026-08-01.
notes: Record text is the whole new Law as adopted (Cyrillic). Art. 219 repeals the Law on Consumer Protection of 2021 (Sl. glasnik RS 88/21) on the day this Law starts to apply (2026-08-01). In the 2026 Law Art. 17 defines unfair commercial practice ("Непоштеном се нарочито сматра обмањујућа пословна пракса и насртљива пословна пракса"), Art. 18 misleading commercial practice, Art. 19 misleading omission, and Art. 20 lists practices misleading in every case (read in the extracted text; the 2021 Law has the same article numbers 17 to 20). The 2021 Law is not stored: its gazette publication date was not read from an official page (the Assembly PDF 2021/1290-21.pdf has none), so its in-force date and the window 2021 to 2026-08-01 are a gap. The Ministry of Trade site (mtt.gov.rs) refused the cloud address (row RS-MTT-ADOPTED). Environmental claims are not named in Arts. 17 to 20: a search of the extracted text for "еколошк" and "климат" finds nothing, and "животну средину" appears only in wording on goods dangerous to the environment (in the list of consumer rights and in the dangerous-goods rules) and in the name of the competent ministry. The environmental-claims rule is Art. 10 item 5 of the Law on Advertising (rs-advertising-act).
